title: Finals Treatment Continuity Launch
acceptance_criteria: The public landing DOM, accessibility tree, and searchable content contain no Maria record, MRN, regimen, facility record, readiness graph, or workspace preview.
Pricing comes from one configuration and presents $18,000/year, $1,500/month billed annually, and custom pricing for larger programs without a self-serve checkout claim.

Google opens /patient, Microsoft /caregiver, Apple /staff, and email /transport without credential collection or an identity-provider request; invalid local route/session state returns safely to /access.
Maria's T-3 submission preserves her clinical words and creates separately owned clinical, transportation, and callback work with deadlines; explicit barriers bypass ML ordering.

Every accepted command appends a versioned event and atomically updates projections, schedules, and outbox records; stale or invalid transitions fail and repeated idempotency keys return the prior semantic result.
Patient, staff, caregiver, transport, graph, timeline, metrics, and evidence views derive from the same persisted event history and remain consistent after refresh.

The long-running Railway API process polls due work in bounded batches while PostgreSQL advisory locks, row claims, and leases preserve one active scheduler authority; stale claims recover safely and uncertain provider sends are reconciled or escalated rather than blindly resent.
Twilio and ElevenLabs live statuses appear only after valid signed callbacks; invalid signatures, duplicates, out-of-order callbacks, STOP, no-answer, and provider failure remain safe and visible.

CareLink records notice cutoff, eligibility and funding, service area, accommodations, outbound and return plans, offer, acceptance, assignment, notification, acknowledgment, failure, backup, escalation, and completion as distinct states.
Transport assignment alone cannot close the blocker; provider failure or appointment change reopens affected work and Maria must acknowledge the complete current plan before closure.
Uber Health and Lyft Concierge remain disabled planned adapters and cannot produce credentials, network actions, callbacks, assignments, or active-trip status.

Ana's server-derived projection contains only authorized transportation logistics; clinical text, nurse details, internal notes, and model output are absent from API, UI, accessibility, search, export, log, and caregiver outbound surfaces.
A clearly non-urgent clinical concern remains under human authority; generic acknowledgment, ML, or provider outcomes cannot create medical clearance or resolve an undisposed urgent concern.

Metrics change only with source events, and FHIR displays Validated only for an exact generated artifact with a passing hash-bound report from the pinned validator without implying Epic or Ochsner connectivity.

Offline Python produces the LightGBM, sigmoid calibrator, feature schema, explanation metadata, seed, training timestamp, and evaluation manifest; TypeScript runtime matches reviewed golden vectors or shows Score unavailable.

Reset restores the exact starting scenario, projections, schedule, and presentation route without sending SMS, placing a call, creating a transport request, accepting a provider callback, or draining outbox work.
Network, provider, validator, or model failure never becomes false success; the affected dependency remains unresolved or unavailable and the governed recovery path remains operable.
Frontend states are complete at mobile and presentation widths, keyboard operable, semantic, visibly focused, non-color-dependent, and equivalent under reduced motion.

The Railway web, API, and PostgreSQL services pass controlled-deployment preflight, including production builds, deep links, API health, raw-body callback verification, tick authentication, scheduler overlap safety, private database connectivity, environment checks, restart behavior, and public callback reachability.

FULL independent testing, current repository verification, focused HIGH-risk security approval, final review, five consecutive rehearsals including one failure, backup recording, human merge, and control-plane closure are required before DONE.
